# The command line the Plan gives the server's Java (<saves> is the instance's saves folder).

## A new world with the defaults
-Xmx2048M
-XX:+UnlockExperimentalVMOptions
-XX:+UseG1GC
-XX:+ExplicitGCInvokesConcurrent
-XX:G1NewSizePercent=20
-XX:G1ReservePercent=20
-XX:MaxGCPauseMillis=50
-XX:G1HeapRegionSize=32M
-jar
Server.jar
-nogui
-datadir
<saves>
-world
My World
-port
14159
-slots
10
-password

-motd
Necesse server
-logging
0
-zipsaves
1
-language
en

## With a password, a name with spaces, 4 players and 4 GB
-Xmx4096M
-XX:+UnlockExperimentalVMOptions
-XX:+UseG1GC
-XX:+ExplicitGCInvokesConcurrent
-XX:G1NewSizePercent=20
-XX:G1ReservePercent=20
-XX:MaxGCPauseMillis=50
-XX:G1HeapRegionSize=32M
-jar
Server.jar
-nogui
-datadir
<saves>
-world
My World
-port
14160
-slots
4
-password
two words
-motd
Friday night
-logging
0
-zipsaves
1
-language
en
